audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart said Mordekaiser won Levels 1-5 while the whys prose on the same page said Aatrox out-sustains from Level 3 on; the packet levelChart also reads Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox/Mordekaiser/Aatrox/Aatrox.
audit.why: Both layers rendered a side that contradicted their own why-text and the packet chart.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Skill, Aatrox, Aatrox, Mordekaiser, Aatrox, Aatrox in matched full+content pairs, with ratings and the phases[2]/[3]/[5] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown text named World Ender as matchup-defining but carried no number, and dosFull[2] title (anti-heal) did not match its description (baiting R).
audit.why: Concrete timers are what make the spike advice actionable.
audit.corrected: World Ender written as 120s at rank 1, The Darkin Blade as 14s at rank 1; dosFull[2].d now tells you to buy Grievous before the 120s R.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places called the chain-pull his E. Umbral Dash (E) is his dash and passive heal-on-damage; the pull is Infernal Chains (W).
audit.why: Wrong slot means the reader tracks the wrong cooldown — E is 9s at rank 1, W is 20s.
audit.corrected: whys[3], wants.foe[1] and early now name Infernal Chains (W) as the drag and Umbral Dash (E) as the heal/dash.
sources: enemyKit W text: dragged to the center
enemyKit E text: passively heals when damaging champions, on activation dashes

edits.before: Full kit plus Darkness Rise — three hits sets your aura burning and the lane flips. E-drag Aatrox off his wave and run the Q-auto-E pattern on every World Ender cooldown.
edits.after: Darkness Rise needs three hits to light and his Q is 12s now, healing off every minion it clips. He hugs the wave and drains back your chip while your E pull sits on 16s.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Aatrox must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: His Q drops to 8s and Umbral Dash heals off every hit he lands, so long trades drain his way. Only punish the step away from his wave.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's burns his HP stack, but his first item and World Ender's heal amp out-sustain it — take short trades, not long.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes World Ender — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Buy Grievous before his 120s R lands — it cuts the amp and E drain.

edits.before: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — His drain ramps in long fights. R him before it matters. Track it before every engage. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: Three swings; the outer-edge sweetspot knocks up and deals heavy damage. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Aatrox World Ender: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, and its heal amp ramps every long fight. Commit while it is down. - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: three swings, 14s at rank 1; the outer-edge sweetspot knocks up and hits hardest. Sidestep it.

edits.before: World Ender's healing amp plus his E chain-pull turns every extended trade into a drain-fest his lifesteal wins before my flat DPS pays off.
edits.after: World Ender's heal amp plus Infernal Chains dragging me back turns every extended trade into a drain-fest his lifesteal wins before my flat DPS pays off.

edits.before: E chain-pull you into his minion wave so his Q wave-hits and heal-on-hit top him back up through long trades
edits.after: Infernal Chains (W) drags you into his wave so his Q wave-hits and heal-on-hit top him back up in long trades

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — neither of us has a real all-in. Aatrox's Q is a slow sweetspot and I have no Darkness Rise aura yet, so we both just farm and set the wave. Dodge the center of his Q; the sweetspot knockup is what chains his combo. The moment I have Q + W I look for short trades: I bank a slice of the damage I deal and take into my Indestructible shield, then recast it to heal, and pre-6 his passive heal-on-hit can't keep pace in a quick exchange. Never trade while standing in his minions, where his Q wave-hits and E chain-pull top him back up.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — neither of us has a real all-in. Aatrox's Q is a slow sweetspot and I have no Darkness Rise aura yet, so we both just farm and set the wave. Dodge the outer edge of his Q; that sweetspot knockup is what chains his combo. The moment I have Q + W I look for short trades: I bank a slice of the damage I deal and take into my Indestructible shield, then recast it to heal, and pre-6 his passive heal-on-hit can't keep pace in a quick exchange. Never trade standing in his minions, where his Q wave-hits and Infernal Chains drag me back for more.

notes: Two flag problems, both left unasserted. (1) Mordekaiser Q Obliterate carries a derived grounding flag; Riot’s description is damage only, so the missingInteractions headline "your Q shuts off Umbral Dash" was NOT written into the page. (2) Aatrox W Infernal Chains carries the same derived grounding flag and Riot’s text is drag+slow only — matches what the aatrox-side audit already recorded. suspectNames flagged "World Ender’s" and "Pop World Ender" — both false positives, World Ender is the real R name. Aatrox side win[] in champ-data/content/aatrox.js is also out of sync with its own whys (it reads Mordekaiser x5 while every why says Aatrox); mirror-fix should be run after this lands.
